request.prompt: Animate this character in a Korean classroom answer-reveal scene. 3D anime-style render. After the writing gesture, she steps back slightly and gestures toward the chalkboard with a satisfied, proud expression and a small nod. Her posture shifts from focused while writing to open and proud after the reveal. The chalkboard itself remains clean — the actual text will be composited later.
